name: Count With Me
description: Four hands-on math games: counting and ten frames, sharing into groups, place value blocks, and word problems read aloud.

about.concept: Number sense: quantities as groups you can see and move, not only symbols. Ten frames, sharing into equal groups, place value blocks and spoken word problems each build the same idea from a different side.
about.progression: Counting to ten and matching a numeral leads to making tens, then to tens and ones in two-digit numbers, then to word problems that need a choice of operation.
lifeSkills: Listening to a problem and picking what to do
